title: Correspondence record
description: The canonical match record: identity, position, evidence, geometry, refinement, uncertainty, quality, coverage, and provenance groups. Training points, fitting inliers, and withheld check points must be disjoint and explicitly flagged. Implementation plan section 6.4.

Covariance2D.description:
A two-dimensional positional covariance.

Non-positive-definite covariance is rejected at construction (WP-08 task 5).
A covariance that is merely *produced* is not calibrated; whether it has been
validated against truth is tracked separately on the correspondence record,
because R-008 is that a mathematically well-formed covariance can still be
systematically wrong.

The components are named ``xx``, ``xy``, and ``yy`` without a unit suffix
because the ``units`` field carries the unit for all three; suffixing each
component would duplicate it and allow the two to disagree.
Covariance2D.title: Covariance2D

CovarianceFrame.description: The frame a :class:`Covariance2D` is expressed in.
CovarianceFrame.title: CovarianceFrame

LocalWarpJacobian.description:
The local linearisation of the source-to-reference mapping.

Used to convert a residual or a covariance between the source and reference
frames. A single scene-wide pixel scale is never substituted for this: local
GSD varies with altitude, emission angle, and terrain across one pushbroom
scene (WP-08 task 11).

Entries are partial derivatives of reference pixel coordinates with respect
to source pixel coordinates.

d_ref_line_d_src_line.title: D Ref Line D Src Line

d_ref_line_d_src_sample.title: D Ref Line D Src Sample

d_ref_sample_d_src_line.title: D Ref Sample D Src Line

d_ref_sample_d_src_sample.title: D Ref Sample D Src Sample

LocalWarpJacobian.title: LocalWarpJacobian

MapCoordinate.description:
A projected coordinate, carrying the CRS it is meaningful in.

The CRS travels with the coordinate because a bare easting and northing is
indistinguishable between projections and between bodies. R-010 is the risk
this guards against.
MapCoordinate.title: MapCoordinate

NmsStatus.description: Outcome of non-maximum suppression against nearby candidates.
NmsStatus.title: NmsStatus

PointRole.description:
The single role a correspondence has been assigned, if any.

Deliberately one enum field rather than three independent booleans
(``is_training``, ``is_fitting_inlier``, ``is_withheld``). The plan
requires that training points, fitting inliers, and withheld check points
be disjoint; three booleans can disagree with each other (a bug, not a
scientific finding), while a single-valued enum makes disjointness a
structural guarantee — a record can only ever have *one* ``point_role``.
``TRAINING``, ``FITTING_INLIER``, and ``WITHHELD_CHECK_POINT`` are
therefore mutually exclusive by construction, which is what satisfies the
plan's "disjoint and explicitly flagged" requirement.
PointRole.title: PointRole

ReferencePixel.description: A position in the reference (LRO or SELENE) image, internal convention.
ReferencePixel.title: ReferencePixel

SourcePixel.description:
A position in the source (Chandrayaan-2) image, internal convention.

Sub-pixel correspondence accuracy is evaluated in this frame (ADR-0003).
SourcePixel.title: SourcePixel

match_id.description: Caller-supplied identity, or an auto-generated UUID4 when the caller has no natural identity for this record. Either way, unique per record within a job.
match_id.title: Match Id

tile_id.description: Always None in this build: no tiling infrastructure exists yet (WP-03). Kept for forward compatibility with tiled pyramid-level matching (WP-04 task 6).
tile_id.title: Tile Id

pyramid_level.description: Always None in this build: no pyramid infrastructure exists yet (WP-03). Kept for forward compatibility.
pyramid_level.title: Pyramid Level

ground_coordinate.description: Optional ground coordinate and frame. MapCoordinate carries its own crs_wkt, so one field covers both the coordinate and the frame it is meaningful in.

prior_displacement_px.description: (dy, dx) — line/sample = row/column = y/x order, matching this project's established internal pixel convention (selene_core.types).
prior_displacement_px.title: Prior Displacement Px

covariance_calibrated.description: False unless the covariance has actually been validated against truth. An uncalibrated covariance claiming calibration would be a fabricated confidence claim.
covariance_calibrated.title: Covariance Calibrated
